name.ja: ＨＧ 1/144 ガンダムバルバトス コンプリートセット

ja: ガンダム・バルバトス 第１形態～第６形態を再現できるオールインパックが登場！
『機動戦士ガンダム 鉄血のオルフェンズ』より、
第１～第６形態のガンダム・バルバトスが再現できるオールインパックをＨＧシリーズで商品化。
ＭＳ本体２機に加え、第１・２・３・４・５・５地上戦仕様・６の各形態を再現する武装／パーツを一式同梱。
既存商品とはニュアンスが異なる　劇中に忠実な成形色を採用。
すべての武装／パーツは、ＨＧ ガンダムバルバトスに合わせた設定カラーを成形色で再現し、
一部パーツは、ＭＳ本体に装着した時のバランスを整えた形状で再現。ＣＧＳモビルワーカー付属。
●　第２～第３形態用肩装甲を、青の成形色で新造！
ＨＧ グレイズ（一般機/指揮官機）に付属していた肩装甲を、新たに青の成形色で新造。
白のホイルシールを使用することで、劇中の設定カラーを再現可能。
●　第３形態用ワイヤークローが、劇中設定色で新規パーツとして登場！
ＨＧ シュヴァルベグレイズ（マクギリス機）に付属していたワイヤークローを、クローを白、基部を紫の成形色で新造。
劇中設定イメージを再現。
●　太刀（柄付き）も付属！
ＨＧ クタン参型に付属した、太刀（柄付き）を同梱。劇中シーンを再現可能。
●　第５形態用腰部ブースターを、ＨＧ ガンダムバルバトスにあわせた形状、劇中設定色に準じたカラーで新造！
腰部アーム付属！
腰部ブースターは、ＨＧ ガンダムバルバトスにあわせた形状、劇中にあわせて白とグレーの成形色で新造。
ＨＧ クタン参型に付属した、腰部アームも同梱。
●　既存商品とはニュアンスが異なる　劇中に忠実な成形色を採用！
セット内容 ：
・ ＭＳ本体×２
第１～第４形態再現用ガンダムバルバトス／第５～第６形態再現用ガンダムバルバトス

メイス／第１～第２形態用左腕パーツ／滑空砲／第２～第３形態用肩装甲／第３形態用ワイヤークロー

en: An all-in pack that allows you to reproduce Gundam Barbatos 1st to 6th forms is now available!
From "Mobile Suit Gundam Iron-Blooded Orphans"
An all-in pack that allows you to reproduce the 1st to 6th forms of Gundam and Barbatos has been commercialized in the HG series.
In addition to the two MS bodies, a set of weapons/parts to reproduce the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 5th ground battle specifications, and 6th form is included.
Adopts a molding color that is faithful to the movie, which has a different nuance from existing products.
All weapons/parts are reproduced in molding colors to match the HG Gundam Barbatos.
Some parts are reproduced in a well-balanced shape when attached to the MS body. CGS mobile worker included.
● Newly made shoulder armor for the 2nd and 3rd forms with blue molding color!
The shoulder armor that came with the HG Glaze (general machine/commander machine) has been remade with a new blue molding color.
By using the white foil seal, you can reproduce the setting color in the play.
● The wire claw for the third form is now available as a new part in the color set in the play!
The wire claw that came with the HG Schwalbe Glaze (McGillis machine) has been remade with a white claw and purple base.
Reproduce the setting image from the play.
● A long sword (with a handle) is also included!
Includes the long sword (with handle) that comes with the HG Kutan Sangata. Scenes from the play can be reproduced.
● The lumbar booster for the 5th form has been newly manufactured with a shape that matches the HG Gundam Barbatos and a color that matches the color set in the play!
Waist arm included!
The lumbar booster has a new shape that matches the HG Gundam Barbatos, and is molded in white and gray colors to match the movie.
Also included is the waist arm that comes with the HG Kutan Model.
● Adopts a molding color that is faithful to the movie, with a different nuance from existing products!
Set contents:
・MS body x 2
Gundam Barbatos for 1st to 4th form reproduction/Gundam Barbatos for 5th to 6th form reproduction
・Each set of weapons
Mace / Left arm parts for 1st and 2nd forms / Smooth cannon / Shoulder armor for 2nd and 3rd forms / Wire claw for 3rd form
Shoulder armor for 4th to 5th forms / Tachi / Tachi (with handle) / Chest reactive armor / Arm mortar / Waist arm
Waist booster for 5th form / Armor for 6th form / Arm machine gun / Waist booster for 6th form / Large special mace
・CGS mobile worker x 1
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE/PVC
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. It is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
